title: Murshid Quli Khan Formally Appointed Nawab
detail: In 1717, Murshid Quli Khan was formally appointed subahdar/nawab of Bengal, marking the institutional start of the nawabi regime. The arrangement preserved Mughal suzerainty while expanding provincial fiscal-political autonomy.

title: Historical consequence
detail: The 1717 settlement consolidated a provincial regime whose elite alignments, revenue structures, and political vulnerabilities shaped the road to Plassey.
